name: Gratecrawler
name_status: Proposed working name, not user-approved canon
description: A hunched sludge creature with porcelain teeth and a rusty drain strainer embedded in its back; it crawls from warned floor grates, plods back and forth, and lobs aimed muck balls.
implementation_status: Prototype 88 integrated; packaged validation passed, live review pending

health.rationale: Prototype 88 approved durability increase from 24 to 72 HP gives the enlarged muck thrower more time to attack. No armor or difficulty scaling; movement and attack cadence unchanged.
health.comparison_note: Full damage/no armor/all hits land. Misses add shots; windup and range reduce practical DPS. Single-target comparisons do not count area collateral. Trial overrides apply only to starter weapons.
